records.text: Erika Kirk wrote that a woman was sitting by 'my family's dedication sign' for restoring Zion Gate in Jerusalem.
records.speaker: Erika Kirk

appearances.snippet: Meet Darla (Romanian Israeli woman; surname unverified), ... a Romanian Jew that now calls Israel home. ... She was sitting by my family's dedication sign for restoring the Zion Gate in Jerusalem.

verification.notes: An archived reproduction of Erika's post contains the quoted account identifying this grandfather as Jewish and describing his involvement with Jerusalem's Zion Gate. This verifies that she made the post, not every underlying genealogical assertion.

sources.title: Archived discussion reproducing Erika Kirk's Zion Gate family post

records.text: Jack Solomon married Karla Frantzve in 2002 and financed the restoration of Zion Gate in Jerusalem.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Carla (Carla Frantzve) wasn't even married to Jack (Jack Solomon) until 2002. ... Solomon is the very man who financed the restoration of Zion's Gate in Jerusalem.

verification.notes: Biographical data identifies Jack David Solomon's 2002 marriage to Karla, and the Jerusalem Foundation independently lists Jack David and Pamela Solomon as donors to a 1984 Zion Gate preservation project. The evidence supports both the marriage timing and an earlier Zion Gate connection.
